checkout_payment_cod_demo_note: Nothing is delivered or collected: this is a demo store.
order_demo_transfer: Do not transfer any money. This is a demo store: the order is recorded, but it is not charged or shipped.
order_demo_cod: This is a demo store: the order is recorded, but it is not delivered and no cash is collected.
admin_settings_demo_store_help: Tells shoppers on the order page that no money is transferred and nothing is delivered, presents the seller as an academic project and takes orders without legal details or a bank account. Turn it off before selling for real.
checkout_payment_card_demo_note: You pay on the test gateway: it is an academic simulation and no real money is charged.
order_demo_card: Payment simulated on the test gateway: no real money is processed and the order is not shipped.
order_card_declined: The card was declined. The order is still awaiting payment; you can try again.
order_card_waiting_demo: We are recording the test gateway's result. Refresh in a few seconds.
error_amount_mismatch: The amount does not match the order total. Open the payment page again.
demo_pay_banner: Test gateway — academic simulation, no real money is processed.
demo_pay_cancel: Cancel and go back to the order
demo_pay_test_cards_hint: Any future expiry and any CVC. Tap a card to use it.
demo_pay_no_storage: The card number is not stored: only the last 4 digits are recorded.
demo_pay_error_card_not_test: Use one of the test cards: this gateway does not take real cards.
demo_pay_not_payable: This order no longer has a card payment due.
demo_pay_unavailable: The test gateway is not active in this store.
